query: How many paid sick days do I get each year?
reference_answer: 8 paid working days per calendar year, prorated for a partial year.

query: How many vacation days are allocated annually?
reference_answer: 15 paid working days of earned/vacation leave per full year, accruing at 1.25 days per completed month.

query: What is our maternity leave entitlement?
reference_answer: 26 paid consecutive calendar weeks per childbirth.

query: How many casual leave days do I get?

query: How many unused earned leave days can I carry into next year?
reference_answer: Up to 30 unused earned leave days at year-end; exceptions require HR review.

query: Can I get paid for unused sick leave?
reference_answer: No. Sick leave cannot be encashed.
